scientific_integrity: Complete analytic derivation is supplied for the stated model; a finite-path exact-rational checker tests independent consequences without constituting an infinite-volume proof. No independent audit or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Single irreversible attempted deposition per site, independent uniform arrival times and Bernoulli species, nearest-neighbor integer lattice, with 0<p<1 and 0<t<=1.
The shifted-geometric conditional law is for maximal clusters of length at least two, sampled by cluster count; singleton clusters have a separate intensity.
No statement about joint independence of clusters or process-level Gaussian convergence.
Potential historical priority outside the inspected primary literature remains unverified.
title: Exact geometric tails for same-species clusters in one-shot antagonistic adsorption
